summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper and enum; nothing committed. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` with the eleven members from the spec table, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made `_should_set_global_sts_endpoint` accept a None endpoint_config (no variant tags); added public `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults(region_name, service_name, s3_config, endpoint_bridge, client_endpoint_url, legacy_endpoint_url)` at the end of ClientArgsCreator. SDK_ENDPOINT is always a key, with value None when absent. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with tests for every behavioral criterion, one dedicated custom-data legacy test and one bundled-data test. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; test_args, test_regions, test_client, test_endpoint together 442 passed. Lint: black/isort not available in the venv, so line length was checked by hand; all added lines are <=79 columns. A pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (~315) was left untouched. Judgment calls: the default-scenario test also asserts SDK::Endpoint absent under bundled data, so it partly overlaps the dedicated bundled-data test; the helper uses the bridge's private lookups _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint because no public equivalents exist.
